messages.content: Should I use UUIDs or bigints for primary keys?

It depends, and people disagree. UUIDv4 keys distribute badly in a B-tree and make indexes larger; bigints are compact and ordered. UUIDv7 is time-ordered and fixes much of that, but support is uneven. If you need to generate ids outside the database, UUIDs win. Otherwise bigints are the safer default. I would not call this settled.
